g.text: adapters merged into the weights after training
No MTP tensors in this checkpoint
The answer is read from lm_head, never generated
Questions are batched; each batch is one forward pass
Next-token logits at the answer position
FP32 softmax over the offered option letters
The rest of the vocabulary is ignored
one probability per option · they sum to 1
